response.description: Developers can now route Stripe events directly into Azure Event Grid and build scalable, event-driven architectures without managing webhook infrastructure or custom brokers.This means that Event Grid acts as a fully managed event broker between Stripe and other Azure services.Now Event Grid can automatically deliver Stripe events to Azure subscribers including:Azure FunctionsLogic AppsEvent HubsService BusFurthermore, because Event Grid has a native connector to Microsoft Fabric, you can now ingest Stripe events into Fabric as continuous streams, where they can be transformed, enriched, and analyzed in real time.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Event Grid as a destination for Stripe events
